::: {#exm-pairs-complement}
#### The strings that fail the check

Swapping the accepting states of the DFA $A$ of @exm-pairs-dfa gives the DFA $A'$ of @fig-pairs-complement,
whose accepting states are $q_1$ and $q_2$.
By @thm-complement-dfa and @thm-pairs-language,
$A'$ accepts exactly the strings in which some $\mathtt{a}$ is not immediately followed by a $\mathtt{b}$:
those with two $\mathtt{a}$s in a row, and those that end in $\mathtt{a}$.
It accepts $\mathtt{aab}$ and $\mathtt{ba}$ and rejects $\mathtt{abab}$ and $\lambda$.
In $A'$, the state $q_2$ is no longer a dead state (@def-dead-state), since it is accepting.

::: {#fig-pairs-complement}
